| συνθεσίαι (τάων ἃς ἐπέτελλε, 5.319; orders given beforehand) | "arrangements" | "arrangements" | "covenants" (kept for the oaths and pacts of 2.339, which are sworn between sides), "agreements", "instructions"; σύν + θέσις "putting together", and the word is the arrangement Diomedes laid on Sthenelus (a departure from the table’s συνθεσίαι "covenants", with the reason: here one man enjoins and the other keeps) |
